description.short: Ask questions and receive task notifications.
description.full: OnBuddy connects your team to your AI-powered onboarding assistant. Ask questions about your onboarding plan, get reminders for upcoming tasks, and receive proactive notifications when work is assigned to you — all inside Microsoft Teams. Requires an OnBuddy account (sign up at https://onbuddy.ai). Admins connect their workspace from the OnBuddy Integration page using Microsoft sign-in; no scripts or files required.
